description: Study 4: long-horizon agentic bias. Bias-vs-horizon curves (identity-free filler doses 0/10/30), context-surgery decomposition (decision-time vs accumulated bias via sanitized-history replay), and the within-trajectory explicit/implicit gap. Mock calibration: gamma=0 must be flat across horizons, gamma>0 must rise; surgery must attribute the planted decision-time bias correctly; EIG must recover implicit bias behind explicit denial.
